model.name: freshnessInvariant.assertNoStoredAndSilent
model.description: Per authoritative-artifact class, assert the freshness/provenance invariant: the class either DERIVES from its single source on each read, or is STORED with provenance revalidated-per-read + rendered visibly-stale on failure; a stored-and-silent class => RED. Enumerate the class corpus by structural discovery with a divergence check (a new authoritative-artifact class matching the meta-shape but unenrolled => flag), and require each class gate to carry a stub-must-fail (R40.54). Routes through the shared structuralDiscover (single-source with R40.54 AcGuard + R40.55 boot-currency).
model.note: Architect wires Class (a truth-decay meta-lint reusing structuralDiscover) + per-class Methods on build-go, then re-inspects; planner stands up the per-class guard tasks; I mint Tests off tester markers.
